title: Survival is the Only Reward: Sustainable Self-Training Through Environment-Mediated Selection
abstract: arXiv:2601.12310v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-training systems often degenerate due to the lack of an external criterion for judging data quality, leading to reward hacking and semantic drift. This paper provides a proof-of-concept system architecture for stable self-training under sparse external feedback and bounded memory, and empirically characterises its learning dynamics and failure modes.   We introduce a self-training architecture in which learning is mediated exclusively by environmental viability, rather than by reward, objective functions, or externally defined fitness criteria. Candidate behaviours are executed under real resource constraints, and only those whose environmental effects both persist and preserve the possibility of future interaction are propagated. translated_title: 《生存即唯一奖励：通过环境介导的选择实现可持续自训练》
translated_abstract: 自训练系统常常因为缺乏评判数据质量的外部标准而退化，导致奖励破解（reward hacking）与语义漂移。本文提供了一个在稀疏外部反馈和有限内存条件下实现稳定自训练的概念验证系统架构，并对该架构的学习动态和失败模式进行了实证刻画。我们提出了一种自训练架构，其中学习完全由环境可行性介导，而非通过奖励、目标函数或外部定义的适应度标准。候选行为在真实资源约束下执行，只有那些其环境影响既能持续存在又能保留未来交互可能性的行为才会被传播。环境不提供语义反馈、密集奖励或任务特定的监督；选择仅通过行为作为改变世界的事件所产生的差异化生存来运作，从而……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种仅以环境介导选择作为唯一学习机制的自训练架构——行为在真实资源约束下执行，只有其环境影响可持续且能保留未来交互可能性的行为才被传播，从而在稀疏反馈与有限内存条件下实现稳定的可持续自训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a self-training architecture in which learning is mediated solely by environment-mediated selection—only behaviours whose environmental effects persist and preserve the possibility of future interaction are propagated—enabling stable, sustainable self-training under sparse external feedback and bounded memory.
